data.title: 松岛满 · 柠檬汽水与假装傲慢
data.action: 双手叉腰站在床铺前，金色双马尾甩动，挺起胸脯却瞬间泄气红了脸，转过身双手捂脸偷瞄，嘴硬地嚷嚷，脚趾在软垫上不自在地抠紧。
data.location: 美滨学园女生宿舍，桌上摆着柠檬汽水拉环罐与彩色维生素软糖
data.lighting: 天花板吸顶灯的纯白荧光与书桌台灯形成明亮清爽的现代卧室采光
data.mood: 笨拙金发傲娇的滑稽与纯情，元气搞怪又极度惹人喜爱
data.description: 美滨学园女生宿舍，桌上摆着柠檬汽水拉环罐与彩色维生素软糖。双手叉腰站在床铺前，金色双马尾甩动，挺起胸脯却瞬间泄气红了脸，转过身双手捂脸偷瞄，嘴硬地嚷嚷，脚趾在软垫上不自在地抠紧。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哼！这可是本小姐作为完美金发傲娇的终极睡衣装扮！雄二你那是什么眼神啊！给我好好夸我啊！”
data.promptProse: Sitting backwards straddling her study chair in her bright Mihama Academy dorm room at night, Michiru wears a cheerful lemon-yellow polka-dot ruffled camisole and matching puff bloomer shorts. Puffing her cheeks out in a flustered, deeply blushing tsundere pout beside an open lemon soda can and colorful gummy packets on the desk, she glares sideways in bashful embarrassment under crisp bedroom lights.
data.animaCaption: Sitting backwards on her dorm desk chair in her lemon-yellow polka-dot ruffled camisole and bloomer shorts, Michiru puffs her cheeks in a blushing tsundere pout. An open lemon soda can and candy packets sit beside the bright desk lamp.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a bright lemon-yellow white-polka-dot ruffled camisole paired with high-waisted ruffled bloomer shorts, showing her bare shoulders and legs.
